description: Extended family members need a fallback contact tree with primary, secondary, and out-of-area check-in rules in case normal communication patterns break down during a disruption.

user_profile.persona: 35-year-old sibling coordinating emergency planning for relatives in several cities
user_profile.context: The family keeps saying they will "just text each other," but no one has agreed on a real fallback structure
user_profile.communication_style: Coordination-focused and explicit, wants roles and routes documented clearly

fact_sheet.fact: Maya Chen, residing in Seattle, WA, is the designated Primary Plan Coordinator.
Robert Chen, residing in Boston, MA, serves as the single Out-of-Area Check-In Point.
Leo Chen, residing in Denver, CO, is Maya Chen's brother and primary contact link to their parents.
David and Susan Chen, residing in Phoenix, AZ, are the parents of Maya and Leo.
Grace Lin, residing in Chicago, IL, is the aunt and primary contact for the Lin branch of the family.
Ben Lin, residing in Austin, TX, is Grace Lin's son.
The Primary Plan Coordinator, Maya Chen, is responsible for updating the plan document annually on July 1st.
Each family household is responsible for maintaining a printed copy of the communication plan, version 2.1 or later.
After establishing their own safety, each member's first responsibility is to contact their assigned person in the call tree.
All family members must attempt to contact the Out-of-Area Check-In Point within 4 hours of a plan activation event.
The plan is automatically activated if any family member is under a government-issued evacuation order.
The plan is also activated if a regional communication outage (cellular and internet) persists for more than 2 hours.
The master plan document is a Google Doc titled 'Chen-Lin Family Emergency Comms Plan v2.1'.
The shareable link for the master plan document is http://docs.google.com/document/d/fictional-chen-lin-plan-12345.
Level 1 Communication is the 'Chen-Lin Clan Comms' group chat on the Signal app.
If no response via Level 1 is received within 30 minutes, proceed to Level 2 Communication.
Level 2 Communication consists of direct cellular voice calls following the defined call tree.
Level 3 Communication, used if cellular networks are down, is calling landline numbers at the top of each hour (e.g., 2:00 PM, 3:00 PM).
All voicemails must follow the 'SALuTE' format: Status (e.g., 'Safe'), Activity ('Sheltering in place'), Location, Time, and ETA for next update.
Maya Chen's (Seattle) first call is to Leo Chen (Denver).
Leo Chen's (Denver) first call is to David and Susan Chen (Phoenix).
Maya Chen's (Seattle) second call is to Grace Lin (Chicago).
Grace Lin's (Chicago) first call is to her son, Ben Lin (Austin).
The landline number for the Out-of-Area Check-In Point, Robert Chen, is 617-555-0182.
The cellular number for Maya Chen is 206-555-0110.
The landline number for David and Susan Chen in Phoenix is 602-555-0134.
The primary email for plan-related questions is chen.lin.plan.coord@fictionalemail.com, monitored by Maya Chen.
The designated emergency meeting point for the Phoenix family members is the fountain in front of the Burton Barr Central Library.
The secondary emergency meeting point for the Seattle family member (Maya) is the Fremont Troll sculpture.
If a primary contact in the tree is unreachable for 2 hours, call the next person on your list and then report the non-contact to the Out-of-Area Check-In Point.
The designated password to verify identity with an unknown intermediary is 'Cactus Sunset 1998'.
